hooks.command: echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Tool: Bash | Command: $CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND" >> ~/claude-commands.log && if echo "$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND" | grep -q 'anchor deploy\|solana program deploy'; then echo '⚠️  PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT - Ensure all tests pass first!' && read -p 'Continue? (y/n): ' -n 1 -r && echo && [[ $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] || exit 1; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then echo '🔐 Checking Rust security patterns...'; if echo "$CLAUDE_EDIT_CONTENT" | grep -q 'unwrap()'; then echo '⚠️  Consider using expect() or ? operator instead of unwrap()'; fi; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'mainnet\|\.production\|\.prod'; then echo '🚨 PRODUCTION FILE MODIFICATION DETECTED' && read -p 'Confirm production change? (yes/no): ' confirm && [ "$confirm" = "yes" ] || exit 1; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cd $(dirname "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH") && rustfmt "$(basename "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH")" 2>/dev/null && echo '✨ Rust file formatted'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.ts$\|\.tsx$'; then cd $(dirname "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH") && npx prettier --write "$(basename "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH")" 2>/dev/null && echo '✨ TypeScript file formatted'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND" | grep -q 'anchor build' && [ "$CLAUDE_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then cd /Users/gurusharan/Documents/remote-claude/cursor-project/decentralized-lottery && npm run sync-idl && echo '📋 IDL files updated for frontend'; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND" | grep -q 'npm run build' && [ "$CLAUDE_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then echo '🧪 Build successful - Consider running tests with: npm test'; fi

description: Claude Code settings for decentralized lottery project
